hermes.title: Hermes
hermes.subtitle: A Hermes instance of your own. Chat lives at /hermes. Model and providers are configured in the container terminal.
hermes.what1: Each subscriber gets a Hermes agent of their own, not a shared chat on the public site.
hermes.what2: Webhooks and messaging (Telegram and others) are pre-wired to your host. You paste the tokens.
hermes.what3: Basic: 2 GB RAM, 1 CPU, 5 GB disk. Pro: 4 GB RAM, 2 CPU, 20 GB disk. The container cannot exceed that. Login stays on Authentik.
hermes.locked: A Hermes instance of your own comes with Basic (2 GB RAM, 1 CPU, 5 GB) or Pro (4 GB RAM, 2 CPU, 20 GB). Already paid? Refresh the session under Account.
hermes.empty: Pick a public name to get your-name.brenon.cloud, with webhooks ready.
hermes.emptyOperator: Operator view. Every customer instance lists here.
hermes.createHint: The default is your account username. You can change it — this becomes your exclusive address on Brenon Cloud.
hermes.createHintDone: One instance per account. The host is the public page; /hermes is the dashboard.
hermes.loadFallback: Could not load instances right now.
hermes.createFallback: Could not create the instance right now.
hermes.startingHint: Hermes is still coming up. Open buttons appear when the dashboard answers.
hermes.homeCardBody: Your Hermes agent on the host you chose.
hermes.destroyBody: Gone forever: container, terminal, volume, chats, memory, skills, tokens, webhooks, DNS and the public page. The host {host} stops existing. Your plan is not canceled.
hermes.destroyFallback: Could not delete the instance right now.
hermes.publicNameHint: The agent host always starts with agent-. It defaults to your account username; you can change the part after the prefix.
hermes.publicLater: Webhooks and the dashboard use this host. Changing it later moves the address; the old one stops opening.
hermes.publicRenameHint: This host is yours alone on Brenon Cloud. Changing the name moves the public address; the old one stops opening.
hermes.publicReserved: That name belongs to the platform.
hermes.publicSaveFallback: Could not change the address right now.
hermes.modelHint: Shortcut: paste your provider key. Full setup is the terminal — hermes setup, hermes model, hermes auth.
hermes.modelSaveFallback: Could not save the model right now.
hermes.cliHint: The CLI opens a shell on this instance’s container. Use it for Hermes setup the screen does not cover — providers, model, auth and the rest of the CLI.
hermes.cliStep1: Open the terminal (same Authentik login as chat). No extra password.
hermes.cliStep2: At the prompt: hermes setup, hermes model or hermes auth — with your own keys.
hermes.cliStep3: Access is only this container. No yum, no host, no other agents.
hermes.cliLimit: Sandbox: 2 GB RAM and 1 CPU on Basic (4 GB and 2 CPU on Pro). Only this instance’s disk. No docker.sock.
hermes.subtitleShort: A Hermes AI agent of your own, on your own address.
hermes.createIntro: Your agent gets {ram} GB RAM, {cpu} CPU and {gb} GB disk.
hermes.dangerBody: Deleting the instance erases its container, chats, memory, skills and address. It cannot be undone.

site.title: Your page
site.subtitle: The instance’s public address. Who can see it is set here. HTML, CSS and JavaScript come from a chat with your agent.
site.dockError: Could not reach the agent right now.
site.dockNotReady: The panel is open, but the instance is not ready yet.
site.dockSessionsEmpty: No sessions on this instance yet.
site.failureConsole: The console could not complete this. The instance may still be up on its host.
site.failureTenant: This instance is not answering. The console is a separate surface.
site.failureEdge: The edge is down. Console and instance hosts are both unreachable from here.
site.failureInstance: This account has no agent instance, so there are no sessions to open.
site.factApex: public page (landing or the app the agent publishes)
site.factTui: Hermes already running in the terminal (not an empty shell)
site.agentBuilds: Ask the agent to build or change the page. This console only sets visibility. Restore default wipes custom HTML.
site.hintPublic: Default: a short Brenon Cloud page with your name.
site.hintMembers: Visitors sign in on Brenon Cloud first. /hermes/hooks stay public.
site.hintAllowlist: Same login, plus an email list you control. You always get in.
site.hintDisabled: The address still exists. Hermes and webhooks keep working.
site.htmlHint: Page markup. Scripts in this field are stripped — use the JavaScript field.
site.jsHint: Runs on this origin. Good for a small web app. No secrets.
site.resetFallback: Could not restore the page right now.
site.loadFallback: Could not load the page right now.
site.saveFallback: Could not save the page right now.
